name: Raika Ikeda
source:
The top otokoyaku. Ever with a shining smile, she is known by everyone in the troupe. Her strength and camaraderie make her a cherished pillar within the Revue, but beneath the playful flirtations lie concealed emotions and shameful secrets.

[From [url=https://yamino.itch.io/black-rose-revue]itch.io[/url]]
